headline.title: ChatGPT Images 2.0 is a hit in India, but not a big winner elsewhere, yet
headline.summary: ChatGPT Images 2.0 has gained significant popularity among users in India for creating various personal and creative visuals, such as avatars and cinematic portraits. However, its adoption outside of India has not yet reached the same level of success.

articles.title: Sources: Anthropic potential $900B+ valuation round could happen within 2 weeks
articles.summary: Anthropic is reportedly seeking to finalize a valuation round exceeding $900 billion within the next two weeks, with investors required to submit allocations in the next 48 hours. This fundraising effort indicates strong interest and potential growth for the AI company.

articles.title: How Shivon Zilis Operated as Elon Musk’s OpenAI Insider
articles.summary: Shivon Zilis served as an intermediary between Elon Musk and OpenAI, as revealed by messages presented during a trial. Zilis, who is the mother of four of Musk's children, played a key role in facilitating communication between Musk and the AI organization.

articles.title: Legal AI startup Legora hits $5.6B valuation and its battle with Harvey just got hotter
articles.summary: Legal AI startup Legora has reached a valuation of $5.6 billion as it competes with rival Harvey in the rapidly growing legal technology market. Both companies have raised significant funding and are intensifying their rivalry through aggressive marketing strategies.

articles.title: TRUST: A Framework for Decentralized AI Service v.0.1
articles.summary: The article introduces TRUST, a framework designed for decentralized AI services to address the limitations of centralized approaches in verifying Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) and Multi-Agent Systems (MAS). TRUST aims to enhance robustness, scalability, transparency, and privacy in high-stakes domains by mitigating vulnerabilities associated with traditional centralized systems.

articles.title: Web2BigTable: A Bi-Level Multi-Agent LLM System for Internet-Scale Information Search and Extraction
articles.summary: Web2BigTable is a bi-level multi-agent large language model system designed to enhance internet-scale information search and extraction by addressing the dual demands of deep reasoning and structured aggregation. The system aims to improve performance on both breadth-oriented tasks, which require schema-aligned outputs, and depth-oriented tasks that involve coherent reasoning over complex search paths.

articles.title: SpatialGrammar: A Domain-Specific Language for LLM-Based 3D Indoor Scene Generation
articles.summary: SpatialGrammar is a newly proposed domain-specific language designed to improve the generation of interactive 3D indoor scenes from natural language using large language models (LLMs). It aims to address common spatial errors and collisions in existing approaches by providing a more effective way for models to understand 3D spatial relationships and physical constraints.

articles.title: Intent2Tx: Benchmarking LLMs for Translating Natural Language Intents into Ethereum Transactions
articles.summary: The article introduces Intent2Tx, a new benchmark designed to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) in their ability to translate natural language user intents into accurate Ethereum transactions. This benchmark includes nearly 30,000 single-step and over 1,500 multi-step instances based on extensive analysis of real-world Ethereum mainnet data.

articles.title: D3-Gym: Constructing Real-World Verifiable Environments for Data-Driven Discovery
articles.summary: D3-Gym is a newly introduced dataset designed to enhance data-driven discovery in scientific research by providing verifiable environments for testing language models and agents. It includes 565 tasks derived from 239 real scientific repositories, addressing the current limitations in evaluating AI capabilities in real-world scientific contexts.

articles.title: Learning-to-Explain through 20Q Gaming: An Explainable Recommender for Cybersecurity Education
articles.summary: The article introduces a new educational framework called "Learning to Explain Cybersecurity with Q20 Game," which utilizes explainable AI to improve interactivity and effectiveness in cybersecurity training. This approach aims to address the limitations of traditional learning methods by providing a more intuitive and adaptive learning experience.

articles.title: Reconstruction by Generation: 3D Multi-Object Scene Reconstruction from Sparse Observations
articles.summary: Researchers have developed RecGen, a generative framework designed for the probabilistic joint estimation of object and part shapes, as well as their poses, from sparse RGB-D images. This approach addresses the challenge of reconstructing complex multi-object scenes, enhancing capabilities for robotics simulations.

articles.title: Lightweight Distillation of SAM 3 and DINOv3 for Edge-Deployable Individual-Level Livestock Monitoring and Longitudinal Visual Analytics
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a lightweight distillation of the SAM 3 and DINOv3 models to enable individual-level livestock monitoring and longitudinal visual analytics on edge devices. This approach reduces the model size from 446M parameters to 40.66M, making it feasible for deployment on commodity edge accelerators while maintaining high accuracy in precision livestock farming.
